definitions.gloss: roar of the sea; rumbling of the ocean
definitions.explanation: A deep, distant rumbling made by large waves out at sea, heard from the shore, traditionally taken as a sign of coming storms.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{海鳴|うみな}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The sea is rumbling in the distance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{海鳴|うみな}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧きた。
examples.english: When night fell, the roar of the sea could be heard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漁師|りょうし}→漁師：21205_ryoushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{海鳴|うみな}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Fishermen long ago took the roar of the sea as a sign that a storm was coming.

notes:
⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ + ⟦{鳴|な}り→鳴る：01143_naru⟧ (sounding, from ⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海鳴|うみな}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the sea rumbles
- {海鳴|うみな}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: the roar of the sea can be heard
- ⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧{海鳴|うみな}り: a distant roar of the sea
